name: clipboard-copy
description: Cross-platform clipboard MCP tools for copying inline text or file contents to the system clipboard from Codex.

args: root="${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$root" ] && [ -x ./mcp-server-clipboard/server.sh ]; then root=.; fi; if [ -z "$root" ] && [ -x ./plugins/clipboard-copy/mcp-server-clipboard/server.sh ]; then root=./plugins/clipboard-copy; fi; if [ -z "$root" ]; then echo 'clipboard-copy: unable to locate plugin root' >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$root/mcp-server-clipboard/server.sh"

interface.shortDescription: Copy text or file contents to the system clipboard.
interface.longDescription: Adds clipboard_copy and clipboard_copy_file MCP tools. The server auto-detects macOS, Linux, WSL, Cygwin/MSYS, and OSC 52 clipboard backends.
defaultPrompt: Copy the latest response to my clipboard.
Copy this file to my clipboard.
